blocks.text: Pitt Meadows condos and townhomes: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to October 2026

Over the 13 months from October 2025 to October 2026, listings of condos and townhomes in Pitt Meadows peaked at 82 in May 2026 and bottomed at 38 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in March 2026 with 21. The reported sale price moved from $699,000 to $632,000, a change of −9.6%.

blocks.text: Pitt Meadows Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Pitt Meadows townhomes sit in three pockets only: Osprey Village at the south end of Bonson Road, Hammond Road at 19696 Hammond Road, and Advent Road at 18960 Advent Road.

blocks.text: Pitt Meadows Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A self-managed eight-home strata like Willow Creek still owes the same Form B package on a resale as a large complex; small size changes who prepares it, not whether it exists.

Stratas with four or fewer lots are exempt from the five-year depreciation-report rule; none of the named Pitt Meadows townhome complexes is that small on the figures read, and Willow Creek at eight homes is not exempt.

blocks.text: Pitt Meadows Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Hammond Road townhomes sit directly south of the CPKC rail line, so train noise is a Hammond Road question, not an Osprey Village one.
The 719/722 loop is the only transit inside Osprey Village; Hammond Road has route 701 on the street itself.
Meadowland Village's rancher form at 18960 Advent Road is single-level living, unlike the three-storey form at Bonson by Mosaic — form, not just age, splits this city's townhome stock.

faq.a: Both names are in use, which causes search confusion in this city. A listing that says only Bonson may be anywhere on the corridor, including Osprey Village at its south end.
faq.q: Is Bonson by Mosaic the complex or the neighbourhood?

faq.a: Willow Creek is recorded as a self-managed strata and the Osprey Village complexes as strata complexes.
faq.q: Are Pitt Meadows townhomes freehold or strata?

faq.a: The Hammond Road pocket is closest, because 19696 Hammond Road sits just south of the CPKC line and Pitt Meadows Station is on Harris Road to its west. Osprey Village at the south end of Bonson Road relies on the 719/722 bus loop to reach either station.
faq.q: Which townhome pocket is closest to the train?

faq.a: Age is the point: a 1989 eight-home strata spreads any roof or envelope project across very few lots, so the depreciation report and contingency reserve fund balance matter more, not less, than in a large complex. British Columbia now requires stratas with five or more lots to renew a depreciation report every five years, and Willow Creek is inside that rule. Read both documents in the Form B package before subjects expire.
